items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: Mr. Hobson who owns Ciro's clubs

ctx.x: Apparently there was an agreement between Mr. Hobson who owns Ciro's clubs, the various Ciro's clubs, and Mr. Sayag, who was Managing Director of the Ambassador in Paris.
And all that was done through La Teague and Fisher's office, a booking office in Paris.
